Title: Successfully add a new holiday for a shop using request body payload
Preconditions: A shop with ID 100 exists in the system
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shop-holidays/add?shopId=100 with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status and body.

Test Data: {"holidayDate": "2024-12-25", "reason": "Christmas Day"}
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains the message: 'Holiday added successfully for shop [shop name]'.

Title: Fail to add a duplicate holiday for the same shop and date using request body payload
Preconditions: A shop with ID 100 exists in the system and already has a holiday on 2024-12-25
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shop-holidays/add?shopId=100 with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status and body.

Test Data: {"holidayDate": "2024-12-25", "reason": "Christmas Holiday"}
Expected Result: Response status code is 409. The response body contains the message: 'Shop already has a holiday on 2024-12-25'.
